target.form: And Thridi said: "Yet first was the world in the southern region, which was named Múspell; it is light and hot; that region is glowing and burning, and impassable to such as are outlanders and have not their holdings there.

And Thridi said: "But first of all there was the world in the south called Múspell. It is bright and hot; that region blazes and burns, and no one who is a stranger there and has no home in it can pass through.
Thus was it ere | the earth was fashioned."
So it was before | the earth was made."
From the bloody surge | and the Blue One's bones.
from the bloody surf | and the bones of the Blue One.
